hero.description: BillGuard verifies Andhra Pradesh electricity bills against official regulatory tariff slabs, checks meter reading deltas, detects unauthorized overcharges, and generates CGRF dispute notices.

auditPage.title: Audit Electricity Bill
auditPage.subtitle: Upload your AP electricity bill for automated OCR reading and statutory tariff verification.
auditPage.dropSub: Drag & drop PDF, JPG, or PNG statement here, or select an option below
auditPage.dropMax: Maximum file size: 15MB • Supported DISCOMs: APSPDCL, APCPDCL, APEPDCL
auditPage.reviewDesc: Review and verify extracted values before running deterministic APERC tariff calculation.
auditPage.auditResultSub: Deterministic tariff computation under approved APERC Retail Supply Tariff schedule.

complaintPage.title: Grievance Notice Generator
complaintPage.subtitle: Consumer representation draft formatted under APERC grievance guidelines.
complaintPage.noDataDesc: Upload and audit an electricity bill to generate a complaint draft based on your verified results.
complaintPage.compliantDesc: The audited bill matches approved APERC tariff schedules. An overcharge dispute is not required.

dashboardPage.title: Electricity Bill Dashboard
dashboardPage.subtitle: Consumer overview of your latest audited statement and APERC tariff compliance.
dashboardPage.noDataDesc: Upload your electricity statement to view your consumption breakdown, tariff compliance, and energy-saving insights.

impactPage.title: Carbon & Environmental Impact
impactPage.subtitle: Environmental footprint estimated from your electricity consumption using the CEA Andhra Pradesh grid emission factor (0.82 kg CO₂/kWh).
impactPage.noDataDesc: Audit an electricity bill to see an estimated carbon footprint based on your electricity consumption.

historyPage.title: Bill History
historyPage.subtitle: Verified records of past electricity statement audits. Chronological ledger of real uploaded statements.
historyPage.emptyDesc: You haven't audited any electricity bills yet. Once you audit statements, they will be securely stored here.

assistant.title: Electricity Assistant
assistant.subtitle: APERC Grounded AI • Statutory Advisory
assistant.greeting: Hello! I am your APERC electricity assistant. Upload an electricity bill or ask me about tariff slabs, fixed connection charges, and official dispute resolution in Andhra Pradesh.
assistant.chipFsa: What tariff slab am I in?
assistant.chipReduceUsage: How can I reduce next month's bill?
assistant.chipExplainBill: What are the APERC domestic tariff slabs?
